bulletPoints: Structural Engineering & Reinforcement Inspection: Verified reinforcement as per STR GFC drawings, column layouts, beam details, PT beam profile duct placements, and MEP cut-outs across Fe250–Fe550 grades for PT beams, columns, shear walls, DG raft, and slabs.
Critical Structural Detailing: Inspected link bars, stirrups, lap lengths, development lengths (Ld), anchorage, and cover blocks from 6th to 7th floor vertical member construction.

Quality Assurance & QA/QC Compliance: Validated batching plant calibration reports for aggregate, cement, and admixture scales; monitored concrete mix designs (W/C ratio & mix proportions), performed compressive cube testing, and tracked Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) to closure.

Site Execution & Finishing: Inspected formwork alignment, stability, VDF floor levelling, PT pocket grouting, plaster quality, surface finish, and curing protocols on the 28 MW Data Center-03 (G+8 Commercial Building).
Documentation Workflow: Checked Work Inspection Requests (WIRs) and maintained rigorous documentation across WIR, SOR, NCR, and approved GFC drawings.
